answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 334 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is recorded against the lagoon challenge, the ferrous audit can replay the jetty history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 1031 identities would post 1577 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
